scope: Retained-source parser and bounded interlinear delta audit; not deployment approval or general philological accuracy

sample.selection: File-order records; random.Random(242362026).sample(lsj_records, 1000), union every record whose entry_text matches case-insensitive word-boundary (sg|pl|dual) followed by a period, whitespace, of, word-boundary
sample.baseline_method: In-memory reconstruction: current parser with counterpart exemption disabled and method version restored to v2. No historical snapshot is claimed for this comparison.
sample.checks: Every old/new accepted span equals the whitespace-normalized rendered source slice, has a resolvable node path, and retains the archived record source URL and verified raw SHA-256. Complete projected results were compared after omitting method-version IDs.

source_chain: Each record points to data/raw/lexica/lsj/CTS_XML_TEI/perseus/pdllex/grc/lsj/grc.lsj.perseus-engN.xml, where N is the second ID component. Archived source_url pins PerseusDL/lexica revision 56061ca127f4a2844980baffc5f2b6d1332897b3. Offsets use uncompacted Greek-span-rendered TEI entry text.

negative_boundaries.finding_fixed: Initial counterpart exception overrode explicit e.g. example markers; final guard retains exclusion using the actual preamble window.
negative_boundaries.coverage: Explicit e.g./E. G. before counterpart labels, absent relation label, punctuation gap, prior citation or sense, nested foreign, quote node, and relation inside a sense all remain excluded. Three first-preamble counterpart variants remain literal.

interlinear_replay.baseline_method: Current interlinear module with shared-sense helper/use and contextual spelling-status exception removed in memory
only_changes: Leda occurrence gains its identical single sourced dictionary sense across all exact alternatives; no morphology candidate is selected.
pacheon occurrence changes syntax gen. masc. pl. to exact contextual source gen. pl.; no gloss added.
damon occurrence changes syntax acc. masc. sg. to exact contextual source acc. sg.; no gloss added.

pytest.command: runtime/venv-syntax/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_lexicon_counterpart_audit.py tests/test_lexicon_senses.py tests/test_lyric_dictionary_gaps.py tests/test_interlinear.py tests/test_contextual_lemma_senses.py tests/test_sense_ranker.py tests/test_campbell_meanings.py tests/test_classifier.py tests/test_passage_analysis.py -q
